email.subject: Congrats on Gilbert—Let's Get the New Team up to Speed on Training
email.body:
Hi [Director of Learning Innovation] and [Learning Technologies Specialist],

Congratulations on the Gilbert property acquisition. We're excited to support your team's growth.

Since your November upgrade to PerformanceHQ, we know you've seen real wins: managers now have real-time compliance visibility, role-based assignment cut admin time, and your teams find courses faster. The Gilbert team will benefit from the same tools from day one.

We'd like to:
- Conduct a quick training-needs assessment for Gilbert's management and leasing staff
- Build location-specific Learning Plans so they hit the ground running
- Brief the new team on the compliance wins you've already realized

Let's connect next week to map the onboarding timeline.

Best,
[Account Manager]

a_1gfsep2.slack: Camden Living acquired a 320-unit property in Gilbert, AZ. Signal: onboard new team to PerformanceHQ + expand Policies (170+ properties + Gilbert, onboarding/standards). Account Manager leads; Customer Success confirms onboarding timeline and compliance gaps. Next: training-needs assessment, Policies demo to Director of Learning Innovation, multi-year renewal conversation with Gilbert add-on and Policies pilot.

email.subject: Welcome Ovilla at Legacy Square to Grace Hill—Let's Fast-Track Your Onboarding

a_1eruma7.signalTitle: New student housing development (San Diego market)
a_1eruma7.goal: Expand from Virtual Tools to Training, Policies, and Mystery Shopping for Akara's new 305-bed student housing development in San Diego, positioning Grace Hill as the platform for full team onboarding and tour quality.

stages.title: Validate
tasks: Confirm new San Diego student housing property specs (305 beds, opening timeline, team size for leasing/maintenance/operations).

Review current Realync ROI data from existing properties: 1,462 video views, 1,100 work-order reduction, 272 maintenance hours saved; confirm tour velocity success (30-60 sec video vs. 45-min in-person).
Check renewal date on Virtual Tools contract and current scope to model the expansion.

stages.title: Align internally
tasks: Brief Customer Success on Akara's maintenance training gap (35% of work orders are appliance, GFI, HVAC, general maintenance—training could reduce further) and leasing velocity needs (student housing has high tour volume and fast close cycles).
Confirm with CS: outstanding support issues on current Realync use, user adoption blockers, and feedback from leasing and maintenance teams.
Notify Director, Account Management of expansion opportunity scope; confirm Account Manager leads (no Sales needed at this stage).

stages.title: Engage the customer
tasks: Email [Director of Leasing and Marketing] with congrats on San Diego student housing close and offer to walk through a onboarding plan tailored to student-facing leasing and maintenance for a new property.
Reference Akara's proven Realync tour success (1,462 views, video-to-tour conversion) and mention Training and Policies as natural extensions for a new team launch.
Propose a brief call to scope new-property team training needs and tour-quality standards.

stages.title: Act
tasks: Present an onboarding plan: (1) Learning Plans for leasing team (tour scripts, student-facing objection handling, lease terms); (2) Learning Plans + Policies for maintenance (video tutorials for common resident issues, self-service FAQ hub to reduce non-emergency requests); (3) Mystery Shopping pilot for 8-12 leasing tours to establish tour-quality benchmark and identify coaching gaps.

Bundle Training + Policies + Mystery Shopping as a student-housing-launch package; offer a 12-month pilot tied to Realync renewal (convert to 2-year Virtual Tools + new services agreement if adoption targets are met).
Confirm property opening timeline and team ramp; establish Success Plan with CS for onboarding milestones (training launch, mystery shops scheduled, adoption % targets).

stages.title: Track & close the loop
tasks: Log in CRM: expansion opportunity, new products (Training, Policies, Mystery Shopping), scope of new services, and 12-month pilot + multiyear renewal conversation.

Success measure: Training adoption (% of leasing/maintenance team completing role-based courses within 30 days of launch) and Mystery Shopping results (tour quality score baseline + 20% improvement by month 6).
Close loop: tie expansion close to property opening date and confirm multiyear renewal offer (Virtual Tools + new services) by end of pilot.

email.subject: Congrats on San Diego Student Housing—Let's Onboard the Team Right
